actorTypes.name: Actor Types
actorTypes.hint: Actor types to monitor. Leave empty to monitor all.

tokenDisposition.name: Token Disposition
tokenDisposition.hint: Only monitor tokens with this disposition. Any monitors all.

hpThreshold.name: HP Threshold
hpThreshold.hint: Trigger when a token's HP drops to or below this value.

hpPath.name: HP Data Path
hpPath.hint: Dotted path to the actor's current HP (e.g. system.attributes.hp.value). Leave empty to auto-detect.

warnings.noHpPath: Deathknell: could not resolve an HP value for actor "{name}". Set the HP Data Path setting to this system's HP location.
